verdict.summary: Round 3 finds no correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security defects. The coverage guard still machine-checks tracked npm lock roots and Dockerfile directories, validates Docker exclusions against parsed FROM directives, and includes non-vacuous negative tests for third-party pins, allowlist changes, and extra stages. The focused test suite passes all 9 tests. Findings are materially unchanged from round 2, so progress is stagnant under the required scale.
